output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The freezeAccount function has an access control issue where the owner can arbitrarily set whether an arbitrary user is frozen or not.
The setPrices function has an integer overflow where the owner can set the sell and buy prices.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the buyer can set the buy price.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the seller can set the sell price.
